invariants.text: Category.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Expense.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Expense.category_id must reference an existing Category.id
Budget.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Budget.category_id must reference an existing Category.id
Budget must have a unique constraint on (category_id, month)
A budget entry must have a unique combination of category_id and month.
When an expense is added, the system must check if the associated category's budget has been exceeded after the insertion.
The monthly budget for a category must be checked against the total expenses in that category for a given month to determine if the budget is on_track, in_warning, or exceeded.
The get_monthly_report method must return the total spending per category and indicate whether the category's budget is on_track, in_warning, or exceeded.
The get_yearly_summary method must return the monthly totals, the top spending categories, and the average monthly spend for the given year.
The get_category_spending method must aggregate the amount_cents of expenses for a given category over a specified date range.
The detect_recurring method must identify expenses with the same amount and category that recur monthly and mark them as recurring.
The expense list query must filter results by category_id, start_date, end_date, and payment_method if provided, and return all expenses if no filters are given.
The add_expense operation must validate that the specified category exists before creating the expense.
The export_to_csv method must export expenses filtered by date range and optional category and payment method into a CSV file at the specified path.
